final: WITH c AS (SELECT p.SEX AS SEX, COUNT(*) AS n FROM Laboratory l JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = l.ID GROUP BY p.SEX), s AS (SELECT SUM(n) AS t, AVG(n) AS a FROM c) SELECT c.SEX, c.n AS test_records, c.n * 1.0 / s.t AS share_of_total, c.n - s.a AS above_average FROM c, s WHERE c.n > s.a ORDER BY c.n DESC
